displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Bryant 288BNV Evolution heat pump or 189BNV air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 53 is 5 short and 3 long
meaning: Outdoor air temperature sensor fault. If this sensor fails, the manual says defrost is initiated from coil temperature and time. There is no reset time on this row.
causes: Sensor harness not connected to the outdoor control
Hardware damage to the outdoor control
diySteps: Count 5 short flashes and 3 long flashes. A heat pump that defrosts on a different schedule after this code is the failover the manual describes, not a reason to add refrigerant
Technician: seat the plug, check harness continuity against the resistance chart, and replace the outdoor control only if its hardware is damaged
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Sensor replacement is not a filter change.
sourceTitle: Bryant 288BNV heat pump / 189BNV air conditioner service manual (SM288BNV-189BNV-04)
